sections.heading: Acceptance
body: By accessing Aeterna Technology platforms, you agree to comply with applicable laws, export regulations, and ethical use standards for artificial intelligence, biotechnology, cryptography, and autonomous systems.
Unauthorized access or redistribution of restricted modules is strictly prohibited.

sections.heading: Service Conditions
body: Certain services require executed agreements or government clearances. We may suspend or terminate access when security thresholds are exceeded, contractual obligations lapse, or compliance reviews identify risk.

sections.heading: Contact
body: Questions regarding these terms can be directed to legal@aeterna.technology. Additional policies, including privacy and acceptable use, are incorporated by reference.

sections.heading: Data Collection
body: We collect telemetry necessary to operate Atlas, NOVA, NeuroWeave, and related services, including access logs, performance metrics, and compliance artifacts.
Sensitive datasets are encrypted end-to-end with post-quantum algorithms and governed by jurisdictional residency controls.

sections.heading: Usage
body: Data enables mission orchestration, threat detection, service improvements, and regulatory reporting. We do not sell personal information and only share data with authorized partners under strict agreements.

sections.heading: Control
body: You may request access, corrections, or deletion of your records via privacy@aeterna.technology. Sovereign clients can activate dedicated data isolation controls and audit APIs.
